capabilities: Import PDF files into the vault via a file picker
Paint permanent marker highlights into the PDF file itself
Save selected passages as quote callouts in a companion highlights note
Reopen the PDF at the highlighted passage via deep links
Configure folders for imported PDFs and highlight notes
extras: Manual installation only (build from source with npm); the README solicits donations via Buy me a coffee and PayPal.
problem: Obsidian's built-in PDF viewer offers no way to permanently highlight PDF files or extract selected passages into linked Markdown notes.
summary: PDF reader companion that imports PDFs into the vault, paints permanent highlights into the PDF, and saves selections as quote notes with deep links.
